items.name: b12556
items.body:
<details open>

model : hrm : do not compute slot count as uint32_t (#32601)

load_arch_hparams multiplies n_hrm_layers_per_stack, n_hrm_h_cycles and
(n_hrm_l_cycles + 1) into a uint32_t, then asserts the product equals
block_count.

Any factors whose true product is block_count + k*2^32 still pass the
assert; 1073741825 * 2 * 2 = 2^32 + 4 compares equal to block_count = 4.

load_arch_tensors iterates the same three values in int and writes past
the end of the block_count-sized layers vector.

</details>
